checks.exercise: Low-handle trap-bar deadlift. Front/side 16 poses and final light/dark 32-frame sheets reviewed.
checks.equipment: Hexagonal frame surrounds the lifter, with side handles and two outer plates.
checks.setup: Hip-width stance inside frame; plates start at foot sole plane.
checks.hands: Neutral side grips; mirrored wrist orientation corrected after preliminary elbow check failed. Both elbows remain about 175 degrees with rigid six-unit grip width.
checks.feet: Both feet remain planted throughout 481 sampled poses; drift below 1.4e-14 model units.
